title: TNAU-affiliated colleges recorded 2026 application and odd-semester registration milestones
description: Understand how TNAU-affiliated private agriculture colleges record application windows (May–June 2026) and semester registration notices (October 2026).
summary: Dated notices from PGP College of Agricultural Sciences (May–June 2026 application window) and Thanthai Roever Institute (21 October 2026 semester registration) illustrate how TNAU-affiliated colleges publish admission and academic milestones.

sections.heading: Dated notices across TNAU-affiliated private colleges
paragraphs: In Agrico’s audited Tamil Nadu research set, [PGP College of Agricultural Sciences](/university/pgp-college-of-agricultural-sciences) recorded its 2026–27 B.Sc. Agriculture application notification on 6 May 2026 with a stated closing date of 17 June 2026, aligned with the state’s undergraduate admission season. Later in the academic cycle, [Thanthai Roever Institute of Agriculture and Rural Development](/university/thanthai-roever-institute-of-agriculture-and-rural-development) published an academic notice dated 21 October 2026 for odd-semester registration of its continuing 2024 and 2025 undergraduate batches.
Separating new-admission application dates from continuing-batch semester registration notices prevents applicants from misreading an October academic circular as a fresh admission opening.

sections.heading: Using TNAU counselling and college notices together
paragraphs: Whether you are researching [Adhiparasakthi Agricultural College](/university/adhiparasakthi-agricultural-college), [Adhiyamaan College of Agriculture and Research](/university/adhiyamaan-college-of-agriculture-and-research), [J.K.K. Munirajah College of Agricultural Science](/university/j-k-k-munirajah-college-of-agricultural-science), [JSA College of Agriculture and Technology](/university/jsa-college-of-agriculture-and-technology), [Pushkaram College of Agriculture Sciences](/university/pushkaram-college-of-agriculture-sciences), [The Indian Agriculture College](/university/the-indian-agriculture-college) or [Palar Agricultural College](/university/palar-agricultural-college), always verify both the central TNAU counselling allotment and the individual college’s reporting instructions.
Read [applying to TNAU-affiliated private agriculture colleges](/articles/tnau-private-agriculture-college-admission) for a complete breakdown of government-counselling and management-quota seats.

faqs.question: Is the 21 October 2026 notice at Thanthai Roever a new B.Sc. Agriculture admission window?
faqs.answer: No. That notice governs semester registration for already enrolled 2024 and 2025 undergraduate batches.

faqs.question: Do all nine TNAU-affiliated colleges in this collection participate in TNAU counselling?
faqs.answer: Yes, they are TNAU-affiliated private colleges, though seat allocation is divided between the TNAU government-counselling quota and the regulated management channel.
